meta.name: verify-cli-run
meta.description: Prove that a command-line tool actually did what it said, instead of trusting its exit code and its output. Snapshots the filesystem before and after, names the expected consequence in advance, and returns one of four verdicts with what could not be seen. Use after running a build, a migration, a scaffolder, a formatter, a codegen step, or an AI coding CLI; when a command printed success and you are about to report "done"; when you are about to write "exit code 0, so it worked"; or when a tool claims it edited files. Needs nothing installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑完命令后核对文件是否真被改动,不再只信退出码和成功提示
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果命令报成功却不确定文件到底改没改
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a command says success but you can't tell if files actually changed

howto.what: 跑命令前先写下预期结果并对文件系统做快照，跑完后对比快照，给出 yes、no、unknown、no-fault 四种判定之一，并列出哪些地方没观察到。
howto.when: 当你跑完构建、迁移或代码生成等命令，或某个工具声称改了文件、你正准备说「完成了」时，它会接管验证。

say.text: 我刚跑完构建，验证一下 dist/ 是否真被重写了。
say.note: 先快照再对比，最后给判定

say.text: 刚才那条命令说它改了 src/config.ts，帮我确认。
say.note: 用工作区 diff 作证据

say.text: 把同一条命令再跑一遍，看第二次 diff 是否为空。
say.note: 检查工具重复运行是否稳定

howto.what_en: After a command runs, Claude snapshots the filesystem before and after, states the expected result in advance, then returns one of four verdicts (yes, no, unknown, no-fault) plus what it could not observe.
howto.when_en: Use after running a build, migration or AI coding CLI, or when a command printed success and you are about to report it as done.

say_en.text: I just ran the build; verify dist/ was actually rewritten.
say_en.note: snapshots, diffs, then gives a verdict

say_en.text: That command claims it edited src/config.ts; confirm it.
say_en.note: the working-tree diff is the evidence

say_en.text: Run the same command twice and check the second diff is empty.
say_en.note: catches tools that keep changing things
